facts.business: Triton Valves Limited is a vertically integrated engineering platform that manufactures tyre valves and cores, and has expanded into climate control and metals verticals through backward integration.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has made investments in, provided guarantee or security and granted loans or advances in the nature of loans to subsidiary companies. Aggregate amount granted during the year: Loans Rs 353.41 Lakhs, Guarantees Rs 4,209.12 Lakhs. Balance outstanding as at balance sheet date: Loans Rs 353.41 Lakhs, Guarantees Rs 4,209.12 Lakhs. Investments, loans and interest receivable of Rs 2,166.87 Lakhs in Triton Valves Futuretech Private Limited and Rs 3,416.55 Lakhs in Triton Valves Climatech Private Limited.
